business_problem: replace hard-to-scale on-premises SAP HANA data infrastructure with a cloud data mesh that could unify structured and unstructured data, support SaaS initiatives, and scale AI use safely.
solution_summary: Siemens uses Snowflake and dbt on Snowflake to replace hard-to-scale on-premises SAP HANA data infrastructure with a cloud data mesh that could unify structured and unstructured data, support SaaS initiatives, and scale AI use safely. Machine, product, erp, and operational data are centralized in Snowflake so business users and data teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. dbt standardizes transformations and data-product development on top of the Snowflake foundation. The platform also connects with AWS, Tableau, SageMaker so upstream systems and downstream consumers stay aligned around the same governed data assets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Siemens achieved 600+ Projects across business divisions running in Siemens Data Cloud on Snowflake and 4,800 Data warehouses integrated into Snowflake.
